title: A$AP Rocky Bolsters ‘Don’t Be Dumb’ With Tokischa Collaboration ‘Flackito Jodye’
summary: Rocky gives Dominican dembow a spin.
contentText:
A$AP Rocky surprised fans with a gift on Wednesday (Jan. 21), teaming up with Tokischa for “FLACKITO JODYE,” which finds the Harlem rapper heading uptown to try his hand at Dominican dembow.

The bonus track appears to be part of the disc 2 Rocky has been teasing as a Don’t Be Dumb deluxe of sorts that’s on the way. “DISC 1 WAS FOR ME , DISC 2 WILL BE FOR THE FANS,” Rocky promised on Wednesday.

DISC 1 WAS FOR ME , DISC 2 WILL BE FOR THE FANS!🔥 #DONTBEDUMB

— LORD FLACKO JODYE II (@asvpxrocky) January 21, 2026

According to Complex , Tokischa and Rocky shot the visual for “FLACKITO JODYE” a year ago, but a leak online derailed the track from receiving a proper release.

The duo injects a dose of NYC swagger to the thumping bassline, which is sure to make listeners’ shoulders bop. “Harlem World like Mason Betha/ Dembow/ I’m a real New Yorker to the Timbo’/ But it really ain’t a hood that I can’t go,” Rocky raps before weaving in some Spanish and repeating the track’s title on the catchy chorus.

The Dominican rapper feels right at home taking turns with Rocky, as she delivers a vulgar verse in Spanish with a booming flow.

Rocky and Tokischa brought their dembow raps to life with a 3D-animated visual, which boasts grainy graphics in the style of a vintage video game.

Tokischa kicks off 2026 by building on the momentum she garnered to close out last year, joining forces with Ice Spice for the bumping “Thootie.”

The Harlem native’s Don’t Be Dumb album arrived on Jan. 16, and there appears to be more heat on the way from Rocky.
